capabilities: Pair a phone or tablet with the desktop without typing addresses or keys
Sync any file type two-way over the local network
Merge concurrent edits three-way and mark overlapping lines with colored callouts
Authorize and revoke devices with per-device tokens
Exclude paths through an editable blacklist
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English interface that follows the Obsidian display language; iOS untested; not an official Obsidian plugin; the plugin's own folder and plugin settings (data.json) are deliberately not synced; text files over 2 MB are not merged three-way.
problem: Syncing a vault between a desktop and a phone usually needs an account, a cloud relay, or manually entering an IP, port or key.
summary: LAN-only two-way vault sync where the desktop serves the vault over HTTP and phones or tablets pair automatically as clients.
